parsed.name: Molecular Devices 多功能酶标仪
parsed.description: 这是一种用于读取微孔板样品信号的多功能酶标仪，可进行吸光度、荧光、化学发光、荧光偏振和时间分辨荧光检测。设备通常用于生化分析、细胞实验、免疫检测、酶活性测定和高通量筛选，并支持控温与振荡等板上实验条件控制。
parsed.description_en: A multimode microplate reader used to measure signals from samples in microplates. It supports absorbance, fluorescence, luminescence, fluorescence polarization, and time-resolved fluorescence measurements. The instrument is commonly used for biochemical assays, cell-based experiments, immunoassays, enzyme activity measurements, and high-throughput screening, with support for temperature control and plate shaking.
